description:
crate-jmap-mail-client/README.md first sentence: 'RFC 8620 typed client methods for JMAP Mail (RFC 8621)'.

JMAP Mail is RFC 8621; RFC 8620 is the base protocol. Remove 'RFC 8620' or change to 'Typed JMAP client methods for JMAP Mail (RFC 8621)'.

Smallest impact of the README issues but it is the very first line a reader sees on the most prominent client crate.
title: P3: mail-client README first sentence RFC mis-attribution
